caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress featuring a checked pattern in shades of taupe and gray, with small green floral motifs in each square of the pattern. The dress has long sleeves with ruffled green cuffs and a high ruffled green collar. The skirt is elaborately decorated with horizontal rows of green ruffles, a green zigzag trim, and a large, draped green sash attached at the waist and flowing down the back. The fabric of the dress appears to be light, possibly cotton or silk, with intricate detailing along the hem and bodice. In the upper right corner of the page, there is a smaller, black-and-white line drawing of the same dress, showing the frontal design and additional detail of the bodice, sleeves, and layered skirt. The background of the page is a plain off-white color.
title: Dress
